sources.label: Singer A
sources.canonicalPcmHashDefinition: SnipSnap WavReader PCM24-decoded float32 /8388607f, hash of LEint32rate+LEint32frames+LEfloat32samples.
sources.cropBasis: Steady interior of the recorded long-tone /a/ near native C4; excludes register transitions and breath releases. These are body cuts, not complete naturally released gestures.
sources.metricDecodeConvention: OriginalPCM16/32768 and expandedPCM24/8388608; amplitudes exactly equal.
sources.attribution: VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset — Julia Wilkins, Prem Seetharaman, Alison Wahl, Bryan Pardo (2018), CC BY 4.0.
sources.performerCreditNote: VocalSet anonymous singer identifier; no personal performer name is asserted. Dataset file labels supply singer, vowel and technique.
sources.acquisitionThisTask: Cached originals only; no network access or additional downloads.
modifications: Cropped exactly to the listed half-open source frame interval.
Lossless integer PCM16-to-PCM24 expansion (each signed sample shifted left8bits); original amplitude retained.
No pitch correction, transpose, time stretch, gain, normalization, fades, filtering, denoising, DC removal, repetition or synthesized replacement.
sources.boundaryNote: First/last samples may be nonzero because a steady-vowel body was cut. Any audition edge fades and level matching belong to the separately declared rendering recipe.

measurementMethod.primaryF0: Python/SciPy YIN cumulative-mean-normalized difference; firstlocalminimumunder.15 over70–600Hz; parabolicperiodrefinement.
measurementMethod.pitchSpread: p05–p95windowF0 in cents; natural recorded microvariation retained.
measurementMethod.crossCheck: Normalized broad autocorrelation and whole-crop harmonic-spectrum observations. Autocorrelationoccasionallychoosessubharmoniclags; primaryYIN avoids selecting a longer period solely for a slightly higher ACF score.
